note: The scenarios offered for play on the table's new game screen (decision 0185). The screen reads nothing else of a scenario. For each, a game is offered only where a file makes it one: the engine's side given orders to its units ("script") or orders for its staff to carry out ("staff"), and a side played by a person or an agent given nothing. Each pairing names who holds each side (person, agent or engine) and the file. Kept by hand: a scenario renamed or moved is changed here. Listed simplest first: by its length and by how much a side has to run.

scenarios.name: The Eastern Solomons
lines: One day of carrier battle. Two American carrier forces lie east of Guadalcanal; the Japanese carrier striking force and the Ryujo detachment come down from the north.

sides.allied: Find and sink the Japanese carriers supporting the reinforcement of Guadalcanal, and keep your own carriers in action.
sides.japanese: Destroy the American carriers east of Guadalcanal, and keep your own in action.

scenarios.name: The Coral Sea
lines: Two American carriers and a cruiser group meet two Japanese fleet carriers and a light carrier in the Coral Sea, while a Japanese convoy makes for Port Moresby with the men to take it.

sides.allied: Stop the landing at Port Moresby and sink the Japanese carriers.
sides.japanese: Land the convoy's men at Port Moresby and sink the American carriers.

scenarios.name: The Eastern Solomons: five days
lines: The Eastern Solomons fought over five days. Two American carrier forces and the Marines at Lunga face a Japanese convoy bound for Guadalcanal, covered by the carrier striking force and the Ryujo detachment.

sides.allied: Keep the airfield at Lunga open, stop the convoy, and sink the Japanese carriers while keeping your own.
sides.japanese: Land the convoy's men and supply on Guadalcanal, shut the airfield at Lunga, and sink the American carriers.

scenarios.name: Guadalcanal: the first thirty-nine days
lines: The landings on Guadalcanal and Tulagi and the weeks of fighting for the airfield at Lunga Point, at sea, in the air and ashore.

sides.allied: Seize and hold Tulagi and the airfield at Lunga Point, to safeguard communications with Australia.
sides.japanese: Hold Lunga and Tulagi or take them back, close the airfield, sink what supplies it, and win the carrier fight.
